Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Record Class Conversation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.hkust.marketplace.services.Conversation
Record Components:
listing - the listing the chat is about
buyerUsername - the buyer in this chat; with the listing, this identifies the chat
buyerName - the buyer's full name
sellerName - the full name of the listing's seller
viewerUsername - the logged-in participant this copy was made for
entries - messages and offers, oldest first
public record Conversation(Listing listing, String buyerUsername, String buyerName, String sellerName, String viewerUsername, List<ChatEntry> entries) extends Record
The chat between one buyer and the seller of one listing, as one of them sees it (UC6 step 2): the listing, the two people, and the history in the order it was sent. It is a copy made at one moment; ChatService returns a new one after each message.

A buyer who has not written or made an offer yet gets a conversation with no entries. The chat thread itself is created by the buyer's first message (UC6 step 5) or first offer (UC5 step 7).

      public List<Offer> offersToActOn()
      The offers in this chat that the viewer can act on now, newest first: for the seller the open ones (Pending, or Countered and waiting for the buyer), for the buyer the ones the seller countered. The deal actions beside Send are built from this (assumptions register 71).
